Name: Canon-Friendly Dialogue Expansion - German
Author: Archer7x
Description:
Help to complete the translation on [url=https://github.com/Archer7x/Stardew-Valley-Canon-Friendly-Dialogue-Expansion-German]Github[/url]!

([b]Work in progress![/b]) Please note that only a fraction of the 4500 sentences have been translated yet.
I am trying to translate everything bit by bit. So it's best to set the mod to "[b]Track[/b]" and regularly press "[b]Update[/b]" in [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/site/mods/1]Vortex[/url][/b]!
This is the [b]German translation[/b]. You will also need the original mod: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2544?tab=description]Canon-Friendly Dialogue Expansion[/url]!
